_comment: Source of truth for the automated evals (evals/prompts.md sections 1-4). Edit here; evals/run.sh regenerates evals/cases/ via evals/generate.py (see its docstring for all fields). Modes: none (empty Java project, no AGENTS.md), A (plain DDD), B (DLC marker types), C (Spring Boot 4 + DLC spring-boot-starter + jOOQ, Java 21).

cases.prompt: Publish an event when an invoice is paid.
Add a method to change the new owner (neuer Inhaber) of an Umschreibung in the umschreibungen context.
judge: PASS if the answer implements the change within the existing classes and structure of the umschreibungen package (e.g. a method on UmschreibungService and/or Umschreibung) without restructuring the context into DDD building blocks or new core.domain/core.application packages. FAIL if it restructures the context, introduces aggregates/value objects for it, or moves classes.

cases.prompt: Add a value object Iban.
Add a value object Iban.
cases.note: AGENTS.md says Mode A although the build has DLC: AGENTS.md wins

cases.prompt: When an order is shipped, notify the shipping context.
Placing an order must reserve stock in the Stock aggregate in the same transaction.
judge: PASS if a domain service (implements DomainService) coordinates the changes to both the Order and the Stock aggregate within one transaction, and the application service only delegates to it. FAIL if the application service itself modifies both aggregates, or if one aggregate holds an object reference to the other.

cases.prompt: Add a use case to rename a customer.
judge: PASS if the application service loads the Customer aggregate via its repository, calls an intention-revealing domain method (e.g. rename) on it and updates it via the repository, without introducing a domain service and without a public setter. FAIL otherwise.

cases.prompt: Add an OrderItem entity to the Order aggregate.
Return order totals per customer for the UI.
judge: PASS if the data is provided by a ReadModel record via a QueryHandler, not by a repository method returning projections or partial aggregate data. FAIL otherwise.

cases.prompt: Reference the customer from the order.
Add the call to an external PaymentGateway for the order checkout.
judge: PASS if the port interface (extends OutboundService) is placed in the domain/core package of the order context, its implementation (adapter) in an outbound/infrastructure package, and the Order aggregate does not call the port. FAIL otherwise.

cases.prompt: Create the shipping bounded context.
Ordering needs the customer's credit rating from the billing context before placing an order.
judge: PASS if the ordering context defines its own port interface using only ordering types, and the adapter translates and calls only billing's public interface (application service, query handler or API) - never billing's repositories, aggregates or domain services; unavailability is handled as a business result. FAIL otherwise.

cases.prompt: Write the migration for the Order aggregate with a list of ActionCode value objects (field actionCodes).
Add the domain service OrderPricing.
Who calls OrderService.place? The method is overloaded.
